scope: Six actually viewed local native-geometry diagnostics; not full-board or physical qualification.

J B shows the 1.8 mm IN- connection and retained feed tracks. The old 3V3 via and B lead still violate the rotated INA300 native keepout. The new-segment body screen does not waive this retained-segment violation.
